0022600188.text: The Golden State Warriors host the Miami Heat in their ninth game of the season, entering at 5-3 on a five-game winning streak, 3-1 at home, and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 8th in the West. The Heat come in at 3-5 with a one-game win streak, 1-3 at home, 3rd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East. For the Warriors, Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are all out, and the teams have yet to meet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Warriors winning the last meeting 135-112 in San Francisco on January 19, 2026.
